value.en: 07's D68 states one part: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control, and lowering the cost of shaping strictly, with nothing else changed, raises it. No live text speaks of open or distributed capability, so reading these as that assistance is this crosswalk's. Capability read as reach, extended without extending the coupling, enlarges the gap (D45). So 'leverage for good and bad alike' is scoped: where those premises hold, the lever has a direction, toward the shapers' control. Neither reading ranks that direction good or bad. [AI reading]
